title: 实验 2-7 · 反相放大器：±9 V 双电源 + 信号发生器
summary: RIN 10kΩ、RF 22kΩ 反相放大，±9 V 双电源：用示波器看 1 kHz 正弦被放大并反相，用直流偏置看符号，再输入过大看削顶。
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **LM358 op-amp**（左侧会自动打开）：虚短、虚断和放大器公式都在那里。
**目标**：搭反相放大器 Uo = −(RF/RIN) × Ui，用信号发生器和示波器观察放大、反相和削顶。
| 电源 | 接法 | 得到 |
| V1（9 V） | − 接 GND，+ 接上方红轨 | +9 V → 8 脚 V+ |
| V2（9 V） | + 接 GND，− 接下方蓝轨 | −9 V → 4 脚 V− |
两台电源串联，中间的连接点就是 GND。这样输出可以是负的，交流信号不用加偏置。
| 部分 | 接法 |
| 输入 | 信号发生器 FG1（黑夹子接 GND）→ RIN（10kΩ）→ IN− |
| 反馈 | RF（22kΩ）从 IN− 接到 OUT |
| 同相端 | IN+ 接 GND |
| 脚 | 名字 | 属于 | 是什么 | 本实验接到 |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A 的输出 | RF 的一端（输出）；CH2 看这里 |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A 的反相输入 | RIN 和 RF 的连接点 |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A 的同相输入 | GND |
| 4 | V− | A、B 共用 | 负电源脚 | −9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | 第二个 op-amp | 不接 |
| 8 | V+ | A、B 共用 | 正电源脚 | +9 V |
LM358 里有两个独立的 op-amp：**A**（1、2、3 脚）和 **B**（5、6、7 脚），共用电源脚 4、8。表里用的是 A；改用 B 也算对——把 1、2、3 脚换成 7、6、5 脚即可。芯片横跨凹槽：上排从左到右 1、2、3、4，下排从左到右 8、7、6、5。
**先预测**
- IN+ 接地，虚短让 IN− 也是 0 V（**虚地**）；虚断让 RIN 上的电流 Ui / RIN 全部流进 RF。
- 所以 Uo = −RF × Ui / RIN = **−(RF/RIN) × Ui** = −(22/10) × Ui。
- 预测下面三种输入时输出的峰峰值、平均值和削顶位置（输出最高 V+ − 1.5 V，最低 V−）。这个电路的输入电阻是多少？
**测量**（示波器 CH1 看输入，CH2 看输出）
| 情况 | 信号发生器 |
| 1 | 1 kHz 正弦、幅度 0.5 V（1 Vpp） |
| 2 | 同上，再加 1 V 直流偏置 |
| 3 | 幅度改成 5 V（10 Vpp） |
电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**真实电路里**：削顶电平仿真里已经有了，但仿真里的 op-amp 没有压摆率限制。真实 LM358 的压摆率只有约 0.3–0.5 V/µs：1 kHz 时没有问题，信号频率升到几十 kHz、输出幅度又大时，正弦波会变成三角波，方波的边沿也会变成斜坡。
startNote: **半成品**：±9 V 双电源、LM358 的电源脚、信号发生器和两个示波器探头都已接好。看一看双电源是怎么接的：PSU2 的 + 接 GND，− 接下方蓝轨，4 脚接到那里得到 −9 V。**为什么**：反相放大器的公式完全由 RIN、RF 和接地的 IN+ 决定。**你要做**：3 脚 IN+ 接 GND，加 RIN（信号发生器 → 2 脚）和 RF（2 脚 → 1 脚）。

en.title: Experiment 2-7 · Inverting amplifier: ±9 V dual supply + function generator
en.summary: An inverting amplifier with RIN 10kΩ and RF 22kΩ on ±9 V: watch a 1 kHz sine get amplified and inverted on the scope, use a DC offset to see the sign, then overdrive it and watch it clip.
description: Look at the **LM358 op-amp** teardown first (it opens on the left): the virtual short, no input current and the amplifier formulas are all there.
**Goal**: build an inverting amplifier, Uo = −(RF/RIN) × Ui, and watch amplification, inversion and clipping with a function generator and a scope.
**Dual supply (±9 V)**
| Supply | Wiring | Gives |
| V1 (9 V) | − to GND, + to the top red rail | +9 V → pin 8 V+ |
| V2 (9 V) | + to GND, − to the bottom blue rail | −9 V → pin 4 V− |
The two supplies are in series and the joint between them is GND. Now the output can go negative and an AC signal needs no offset.
**Circuit**
| Part | Wiring |
| input | function generator FG1 (black clip to GND) → RIN (10kΩ) → IN− |
| feedback | RF (22kΩ) from IN− to OUT |
| non-inverting input | IN+ to GND |
**LM358 pins**
| Pin | Name | Belongs to | What it is | Connect to (this lab) |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A's output | one end of RF (the output); CH2 here |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A's inverting input | the RIN–RF junction |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A's non-inverting input | GND |
| 4 | V− | shared by A and B | negative supply pin | −9 V |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | the second op-amp | nothing |
| 8 | V+ | shared by A and B | positive supply pin | +9 V |

An LM358 holds two independent op-amps: **A** (pins 1, 2, 3) and **B** (pins 5, 6, 7), sharing supply pins 4 and 8. The table uses A; using B is also correct — just use pins 7, 6, 5 instead of 1, 2, 3. The chip straddles the trench: top row 1, 2, 3, 4 from left to right, bottom row 8, 7, 6, 5.
**Predict first**
- IN+ is grounded, so the virtual short keeps IN− at 0 V too (a **virtual ground**); with no input current, RIN's current Ui / RIN all flows into RF.
- So Uo = −RF × Ui / RIN = **−(RF/RIN) × Ui** = −(22/10) × Ui.
- Predict the peak-to-peak output, its average and where it clips (the output reaches V+ − 1.5 V at most and V− at least) for the three inputs below. What is this circuit's input resistance?
**Measure** (scope CH1 on the input, CH2 on the output)
| Case | Generator |
| 1 | 1 kHz sine, amplitude 0.5 V (1 Vpp) |
| 2 | the same plus a 1 V DC offset |
| 3 | amplitude 5 V (10 Vpp) |
Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**In a real circuit**: the clipping levels are in the simulator, but its op-amp has no slew-rate limit. A real LM358 slews at only about 0.3–0.5 V/µs: no problem at 1 kHz, but at tens of kHz with a large output swing a sine turns into a triangle and square-wave edges become ramps.
en.startNote: **Half-built**: the ±9 V dual supply, the LM358's supply pins, the function generator and both scope probes are wired. Have a look at the dual supply: PSU2's + goes to GND and its − to the bottom blue rail, and pin 4 goes there for −9 V. **Why**: the inverting amplifier's formula is set entirely by RIN, RF and the grounded IN+. **Your job**: wire pin 3 IN+ to GND, add RIN (generator → pin 2) and RF (pin 2 → pin 1).

measurements.ask: 1 kHz, amplitude 0.5 V (1 Vpp): CH2 (output) Vpp
measurements.explain: |Uo| = 2.2 × 1 Vpp = 2.2 Vpp; the generator's 50 Ω and the 10 kΩ input resistance divide, leaving 0.995 Vpp at the port, so about 2.19 Vpp.

measurements.ask: Same state: output amplitude / input amplitude (CH2 / CH1, the voltage at the generator's terminal)
measurements.explain: Using the terminal voltage, |Uo / Ui| = RF / RIN = 22 / 10 = 2.2. The scope also shows the two waves inverted (180° apart).

measurements.ask: With a 1 V offset: multimeter DC range, OUT to GND (the average)
measurements.explain: DC is amplified and inverted too: −2.2 × 0.995 ≈ −2.19 V. IN− stays at 0 V (virtual ground).

measurements.ask: Amplitude 5 V (10 Vpp): the output maximum
measurements.explain: ±11 V in theory, but the output tops out at V+ − 1.5 V ≈ +7.5 V.
The LM358 output can swing all the way down to V− = −9 V: the clipping is lopsided.

hints: Dual supply: two 9 V supplies in series, the middle point is GND. V1 + → op-amp pin 8, V2 − → op-amp pin 4.
IN+ (pin 3) to GND; generator + → RIN → IN− (pin 2); RF between IN− and OUT (pin 1).
Place two scope probes (CH1 input, CH2 output), both ground clips on GND, and compare the two traces on the scope.
tests: 1 kHz, 1 Vpp sine: the output is amplified, average 0 V
1 V offset added: DC is amplified and inverted too; IN− is a virtual ground
10 Vpp input: the output clips at the top and bottom

tests.name: 1 kHz、1 Vpp 正弦：输出被放大、平均 0 V
加 1 V 偏置：直流也被放大并反相，IN− 是虚地
输入 10 Vpp：输出上下削顶

compare:
**对比**：Uo = 0 − RF × Ui / RIN = **−2.2 Ui**，输入电阻就是 RIN = 10kΩ。
1. 输出 ≈ **2.19 Vpp**，平均 0 V，和输入反相（相差 180°）。为什么不是 2.2 Vpp？信号发生器有 50Ω 输出电阻，接上 10kΩ 输入电阻后它的端口电压只有 1 × 10000 / 10050 ≈ 0.995 Vpp，以端口电压算增益正好 2.20；
2. 输出平均值 ≈ **−2.19 V**——直流也被放大并反相；IN− 一直在 0 V（虚地）；
3. 理论输出 22 Vpp，但输出最高只到 V+ − 1.5 = **+7.5 V**，最低到 V− = **−9 V**——上下削顶不对称，这是 LM358 的特点（输出能到负电源，到不了正电源）。

measurements.ask: 1 kHz、幅度 0.5 V（1 Vpp）：CH2（输出）的 Vpp
measurements.explain: |Uo| = 2.2 × 1 Vpp = 2.2 Vpp；信号发生器的 50 Ω 和 10 kΩ 输入电阻分压，端口只有 0.995 Vpp，所以约 2.19 Vpp。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：输出幅度 / 输入幅度（CH2 / CH1，信号发生器端口的电压）
measurements.explain: 以端口电压算 |Uo / Ui| = RF / RIN = 22 / 10 = 2.2。示波器上还能看到两条波形反相（相差 180°）。

measurements.ask: 加 1 V 偏置：万用表直流档测 OUT 对 GND（平均值）
measurements.explain: 直流也被放大并反相：−2.2 × 0.995 ≈ −2.19 V。IN− 一直在 0 V（虚地）。

measurements.ask: 幅度 5 V（10 Vpp）：输出的最大值
measurements.explain: 理论 ±11 V，但输出最高只有 V+ − 1.5 V ≈ +7.5 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：输出的最小值
measurements.explain: LM358 的输出能一直到负电源 V− = −9 V：上下削顶不对称。

hints: 双电源：两台 9 V 电源串联，中点是 GND。V1 + → op-amp（运算放大器） 8 脚，V2 − → op-amp 4 脚。
IN+（3 脚）接 GND；信号发生器 + → RIN → IN−（2 脚）；RF 在 IN− 和 OUT（1 脚）之间。
放两个示波器探头（CH1 输入、CH2 输出），黑夹子都接 GND，在示波器上对比两条波形。
